generated.note: what the song asks for, how fast, and what a rig must supply. trust is honest: low means the field it came from is known to be unreliable and should not carry a gesture yet.

dmx.note: nothing finer than one frame reaches a lamp

dimensions.what: drum hits, including the ones off the beat
dimensions.note: the times are only as good as the onset detector; see the accents score

dimensions.what: how far the sixteenths sit off the grid
dimensions.note: a swing narrower than one DMX frame cannot be sent down the wire

dimensions.what: how much is going on: loudness and fullness together
dimensions.note: energy and density correlate 0.83, so they are one axis, not two

dimensions.what: bars where loudness and fullness disagree
dimensions.note: a filter opening rather than instruments arriving; nothing reads this yet
few distinct chords means colour has little to say; and the quality of each chord is unreliable, only the root
a range this wide is not one melodic line -- the tracker is following different sources -- so do not build a spatial gesture on it yet
on the-nights it correlates -0.53 with drum hits: when the voice is exposed the drums back off

not_measured.what: whether a bar repeats something already heard
not_measured.why_it_matters: a show should repeat where the song repeats and change where it changes, and nothing in the map says which is which. This is 'it feels repetitive'.
a stereo field has a width and a rig has a width; matching them is free
not_measured.how: listen/stereo.py exists but nothing writes this field yet

not_measured.what: bright or dark, independent of loud or quiet
not_measured.why_it_matters: what separates a filtered build from a loud verse
not_measured.how: observations.brightness exists and nothing reads it; note that analysis at 22.05 kHz truncates everything above 11 kHz
